name: Jellyfin Federation
description: Aggregate content from multiple Jellyfin servers into unified virtual libraries
overview: The Jellyfin Federation Plugin allows you to create a unified media library by aggregating content from multiple remote Jellyfin servers. Stream content from any server without file synchronization.
changelog: Federated titles from a friend's server in Direct mode now stream straight from that server to your device instead of through your own server's upload, so they start much faster. Apps like Findroid that ask your server for the file are sent to the friend's server too. A file that already fits your connection is no longer re-encoded by the friend's server, the connection-speed test no longer underestimates fast servers, a friend whose address redirects to https is now reached over https, and the hourly sync no longer rewrites every federated item.
